receipts.first_text_witness: There's a specific moment that happens at every car dealership in America. The paperwork is on the desk, the pen is hovering, and the salesman asks the question he's asked a thousand times. So, how are we handling payment today? And you, proud of the savings account you've been feeding for 3 years, slide a cashier's check across the desk. $35,000, all of it. The salesman smiles a smile that looks like approval, nods a nod that looks like respect,
receipts.last_text_witness: going to save you a few thousand bucks per trade cycle. Over a lifetime of buying cars every 7 or 8 years, that adds up to real money. The kind of money that buys actual things, not just the feeling of being responsible. If this video saved you a few thousand dollars on your next car, or even just made you check the rate one more time before writing the check, hit subscribe. I'll see you on the next one.
